name: SpecStream
description: Live web data for your agent. Describe the records you need in plain words (companies, local businesses, people, SEC filings, jobs, grants, tenders) and get structured rows from the live web, always up to date. Search tools hand an agent pages to read; SpecStream hands it finished data, priced before anything runs, with a spending cap the model can't raise.
author: SpecStream

tools.name: compile
tools.title: Understand a request
tools.description: Read a request for a list, written in everyday words in any language: companies and local businesses, products and stores, jobs, papers, clinical trials, grants, tenders, datasets, repositories and packages, apps, books or podcasts. Return how SpecStream understood it: what to find, the conditions every result must meet, the facts to bring back (required or optional), how many, and in what order, with the ast_hash that identifies this reading. To add facts to, extend or refresh a list you have, name it with its parent_find_id and the operation: what it finds and its conditions stay as they are, and only the new facts to bring back or the new count are read. The caller must be allowed to read that list. Nothing runs and nothing is charged.

tools.name: quote_capacity_work
tools.title: Get a quote
tools.description: Price the reading identified by ast_hash before anything runs. Operation find prices a new request, extend more results, add_facts more facts on results the user has, and refresh a recheck of them; the last three take parent_find_id. For an imported list, find with source_import_id and its source_row_ids fills in details or checks each row. The quote shows the most the work can cost. Nothing is spent.

tools.title: Approve a quote

SpecStream then reads the live web and charges for delivered results at the quoted rate, plus the checks the quote lists, never more than the ceiling.

tools.name: get_capacity_execution

tools.name: update_cloud_import

tools.name: list_activity
tools.title: Read activity
tools.description: Read what happened across the account and its projects, and who did it.

tools.name: save_relationships

tools.name: list_web_sources
tools.title: List website sources
tools.description: List the website sources saved in a project.

tools.name: get_web_source
tools.title: Read a website source
tools.description: Read a saved website source and how each column is read.

tools.name: preview_web_source
tools.title: Read a website source again
tools.description: Read a saved source's page again and preview its rows. Earlier lists stay unchanged.

tools.name: get_web_source_preview

tools.description: Read one source preview with its rows, cell locations and field explanations.

tools.name: save_web_source_list
tools.title: Save a source preview as a list
tools.description: Save a preview the user reviewed as an imported list, using its preview hash. Saving does not research or spend.

tools.name: get_reconciliation_fields
tools.title: List fields to match on
tools.description: Read the fields of a list the user can open, with examples, to choose which fields to match against another list. Changes nothing.

tools.name: list_reconciliations
tools.title: List recent comparisons
tools.description: List the latest comparisons that include a list. Comparisons are kept for 30 days; a list filled from one is kept as its own list.

tools.name: prepare_reconciliation
tools.title: Compare two lists
tools.description: Propose which rows in one list correspond to rows in another, using matching groups of exact or close-spelling rules (any group can match; every rule in a group must agree) and conflict fields that rule a pair out. Shows alternatives, conflicts and missing values. A close spelling is not proof of the same company, and one candidate is not permission to choose it. No search and no charge.

tools.name: get_reconciliation
tools.title: Read a comparison
tools.description: Read the proposed pairs, alternatives, conflicts and missing values of a comparison. Refuses if either list changed since it was prepared.

tools.name: apply_reconciliation
tools.title: Fill a list from chosen pairs
tools.description: Only after the user chooses the pairs: fill empty cells into a NEW list from the chosen counterpart rows, using the exact comparison hash. Original cells and lists stay unchanged and unmatched rows are kept. Filled cells are inputs, not checked results; researching them needs a normal quote and approval.

tools.name: get_reconciled_input
tools.title: Read where filled cells came from
tools.description: Read, for a list made by apply_reconciliation, which chosen pair filled each cell.

tools.name: get_investigation_parameters
tools.title: List a request's possible inputs

tools.name: get_investigation_inputs

tools.name: approve_investigation_batch

tools.name: cancel_investigation_batch
tools.title: Stop a run over list rows
tools.description: Stop searches that haven't started and cancel running ones where possible. Finished results stay yours.

tools.name: get_investigation_results
tools.title: Read a run's results by row
tools.description: Read each input row with the results it led to, including their sources. Input values are never treated as sources for results.

tools.title: List automatic research rules

tools.name: get_research_rule
tools.title: Read an automatic research rule
tools.description: Read a rule's limits, what it has spent, which rows are waiting and its recent runs.

tools.name: approve_research_rule
